    The distinguished stable socle extension #

    At a nonprojective indecomposable endpoint over an algebraically closed field, the residue map of the local endomorphism algebra descends to stable endomorphisms and takes the stable identity to one. Stable Hom--Ext duality transports this functional to a nonzero extension class whose pullback along every nonretraction vanishes. Consequently every short exact sequence realizing the class has right almost-split terminal map.
